title: Count Binary Substrings
description: A substring is balanced when it contains the same positive number of consecutive `0` characters followed by consecutive `1` characters, or the same number of consecutive `1` characters followed by `0` characters. Given a non-empty binary string, return the number of balanced substrings. Input: `s` containing only 0 and 1. Output: the count.
hints: Keep track of the smallest state needed to continue matching or comparing characters.
Test empty, one-character, repeated-character, and boundary inputs.
